name: Lottery
overview: Scripture warns against the pursuit of wealth through greed and vanity, as seen in Proverbs where those eager for gain risk losing their lives and wealth gained without labor will diminish. The Lord as our shepherd ensures we lack nothing, encouraging trust in His provision rather than seeking fortune through the lottery. Jesus teaches that one cannot serve both God and money, highlighting the spiritual danger of making mammon a master. True faith, as illustrated in Mark, calls for confident trust in God's power rather than reliance on chance or quick riches.
